text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"So strong, so dominant, Grass Wonder!
Truly living up to the title of the 'Second Monster'!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH...!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder brilliantly displayed skill
that overwhelmed her peers, standing at the very top.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Still bearing the name ‘Monster II’ upon her back...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, I losttt...!
Grass-chan, you really are so fast...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I've still got a long way to go...
I have to train so much more!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Man, the intensity before the goal line
was nothing short of incredible. ...She got me good.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Fufu, I'm honored~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: —Grass.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh, my... El.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nggghhh,
It's so frustrating! Frustrating! Frustrating, I sayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I couldn't catch up to you! You stayed ahead of me!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, quite the contrary...
I am... your...!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Grass.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Next, I'll be running in the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: As the one who will prove to be the "World's Strongest"!In the only domestic GⅠ where overseas Umamusume gather!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: So――Grass, please enter too.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...To the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Si, exactly! Please participate!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Enter, just one more time!!
Please, race against me one more time!!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
choice_data_list: Are you going to run in the "Japan Cup"?
Are you running in the "Japan Cup"?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...To be honest, I hadn't really thought about it.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Considering gaining experience in the Classics,
the next step on the royal road would be the 'Kikuka Sho'—"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: "Or, considering her aptitudes, she should aim for races like the 'Tenno Sho (Autumn)'."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Oh? But looking at El-chan,
the Japan Cup sure looks interesting!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...! Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hiii, great work, darling♪
Congrats on 1st place!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You really caught me by surprise earlier!
I came to watch my cute juniors' race, and you went and made such a fiery declaration of war!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Oh my... You were watching just now, weren't you?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yes! The thing is, you see...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Actually, El Condor Pasa-chan
is a girl I've been pretty curious about~♪

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: ...Is that how it is?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Because isn't it cute? How she doesn't even try to hide her raw fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: That's true, unexpectedly—

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
“Maybe El-chan is the one
who's more like a ‘Monster II’♪”

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, crap!
I completely forgot I'm on a tight schedule.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Bye, Grass-chan♪
I'm already looking forward to your next race~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After speaking with Maruzensky, Grass Wonder remained silent for a while.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then, on the way home—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...I apologize
for showing such hesitation.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: However, my mind was made up.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer—
Please enter me into the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...If I cannot even be "The Monster II,"
how could I ever hope to beat Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Once more, I must demonstrate it.
My true prowess as a "monster."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Bathed in the setting sun, Grass Wonder's fighting spirit swelled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her next goal has been set...
The Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Next time... Next time,
I will run ahead of you, Grass!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And so,
I'll burn the sight of my back into your eyes!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
...No matter how monumental the presence
reflected in your eyes right now may be...!!
